quick_tips_en: Kraków uses the Polish zloty (PLN) — city-centre kantors (exchange offices) offer better rates than banks, but always check the commission.
The Old Town and Wawel Castle are walkable — the castle overlooks the Vistula and is the symbol of Polish royal history: book tickets online to avoid queues.
The Jewish quarter of Kazimierz (the set of Schindler's List) is the city's alternative heart — excellent restaurants, bars with live klezmer music and art galleries.
Auschwitz-Birkenau is just 70 km away (bus/train) — a profoundly important visit: book the guided tour online months in advance in high season.
Kraków has Poland's most vibrant nightlife — the cellars (piwnice) under the Rynek Główny are iconic and prices are very low compared to Western Europe.

foods.name: Pierogi
foods.description: Ravioli polacchi ripieni di patate e formaggio, carne, funghi, cavolo o frutta, bolliti e spesso ripassati con burro e cipolla. A Cracovia sono un piatto essenziale: morbidi, versatili, popolari e capaci di raccontare sia cucina domestica sia tavole tradizionali.
foods.description_en: Polish dumplings filled with potatoes and cheese, meat, mushrooms, cabbage or fruit, boiled and often finished with butter and onion. In Krakow they are essential: soft, versatile, popular and able to express both home cooking and traditional tables.

foods.name: Obwarzanek krakowski
foods.description: Anello di pane intrecciato, prima bollito e poi cotto al forno, cosparso di sale, semi di papavero o sesamo. È lo street food simbolo di Cracovia: crosta sottile, interno elastico, profumo tostato e una presenza quotidiana nei chioschi del centro.
foods.description_en: A braided bread ring, first boiled and then baked, sprinkled with salt, poppy seeds or sesame. It is Krakow’s symbolic street food: thin crust, elastic interior, toasted aroma and a daily presence at city-centre stalls.
foods.description_fr: Un anneau de pain tressé, d'abord bouilli puis cuit au four, saupoudré de sel, sésame ou graines de pavot. Vendu depuis des siècles par les vendeurs de rue cracoviens, il bénéficie d'une indication géographique protégée unique dans son genre.

foods.description: Cheesecake polacca a base di twaróg, formaggio fresco compatto e leggermente acidulo, spesso con uvetta, vaniglia o cioccolato. neighborhoods.description: Il centro storico di Cracovia, Patrimonio UNESCO, con la grande Piazza del Mercato (Rynek Główny), il Castello di Wawel e le migliori attrazioni a portata di piedi. Atmosfera storica e vivace, ottima scelta di ristoranti e hotel. Prezzi più alti ma comodità massima.
neighborhoods.description_en: Krakow's UNESCO historic centre, with the large Market Square (Rynek Główny), Wawel Castle and the best attractions within walking distance. Historic and lively atmosphere, excellent choice of restaurants and hotels. Higher prices but maximum convenience.

neighborhoods.name: Kazimierz
neighborhoods.description: L'ex quartiere ebraico è oggi il cuore bohémien e artistico di Cracovia. Sinagoghe, gallerie d'arte, caffè vintage, ristoranti con cucina ebraica e polacca, bar e club alla moda. Atmosfera unica, molto amato dai giovani e dai viaggiatori indipendenti.
neighborhoods.description_en: The former Jewish quarter is today the bohemian and artistic heart of Krakow. Synagogues, art galleries, vintage cafés, Jewish and Polish cuisine restaurants, trendy bars and clubs. Unique atmosphere, very popular with young people and independent travellers.
neighborhoods.description_fr: L’ancien quartier juif est aujourd’hui le cœur bohème et artistique de Cracovie. Synagogues, galeries d’art, cafés vintage, restaurants de cuisines juive et polonaise, bars tendance et clubs. Une atmosphère unique, très appréciée des jeunes et des voyageurs indépendants.

neighborhoods.name: Podgórze
neighborhoods.description: Quartiere sulla riva sud della Vistola, in forte crescita artistica. Qui si trovava il Ghetto ebraico durante la WWII (Schindler's Factory è qui). Oggi è un quartiere autentico con caffè indipendenti, street art e prezzi accessibili. Ideale per chi vuole sfuggire al turismo di massa.
neighborhoods.description_en: District on the south bank of the Vistula, with a growing artistic scene. The Jewish Ghetto during WWII was here (Schindler's Factory is here). Today it is an authentic neighbourhood with independent cafés, street art and affordable prices. Ideal for those wanting to escape mass tourism.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Quartier de la rive sud de la Vistule, doté d’une scène artistique en plein essor. Le ghetto juif de la Seconde Guerre mondiale se trouvait ici, ainsi que l’usine de Schindler. C’est aujourd’hui un quartier authentique, avec cafés indépendants, art urbain et prix abordables. Idéal pour échapper au tourisme de masse.

neighborhoods.description: Quartiere residenziale a est del centro storico, tranquillo e ben collegato in tram. Prezzi molto contenuti, atmosfera locale e autentica. Ottima alternativa economica al centro per chi vuole dormire bene spendendo poco.
